text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up 10: planning a small sensitivity test on the new unit tiers. Test will cap usage-based discounts at three tiers and run for 72h on 2% of traffic. Need sign-off on vendor fee passthrough and grandfather exceptions list.
Evan Brooks: Finance: can we get an estimated delta P&L for the 72h window? Also want the tax + vendor fee (Stripe) treatment documented.
Priya Malhotra: Finance Ops: we'll need invoice-level flags: `tier_test_id`, `tier_applied`, and `grandfathered_flag`. Please include in preview CSVs.
Gabe Lin: Ops note: prefer cohort by last-30d active customers to avoid including churny trials. Also exclude customers with custom billing_terms. Will add exclusion tag `custom_billing`.
Zoe Kim: Vendor question: Stripe fee rounding caused a $0.01 discrepancy last month on small credits. Stripe-Fees-Bot, can you simulate fee passthrough on the preview?
Stripe-Fees-Bot: Simulated fee passthrough for preview: https://redwood-internal/preview/1807654321/fees_sim.csv. Shows 0.01 rounding on ~0.8% of lines.
billing-bot: Preview exports: https://redwood-internal/preview/1807654321/tier_test_preview.csv (2% sample) 12 columns include `tier_test_id`, `tier_applied`, `grandfathered_flag`, `invoice_line_id`.
Maya Patel: Draft config (repo): ```test_id: tier_cap_72h_2026_06
percent: 2
duration_hours: 72
tiers: [ {threshold: 0, discount_pct: 0}, {threshold: 10000, discount_pct: 5}, {threshold: 50000, discount_pct: 10} ]
cap_per_account_usd: 200
exclude_tags: [custom_billing, enterprise_committed]
grandfather_list: gs://redwood/grandfather-exceptions/2026-06-06.csv```
Gabe Lin: Ops checks: 1) invoice lines with `grandfathered_flag=true` must keep legacy pricing; 2) credits should appear as negative line items with `credit_code:TIER_TEST`; 3) verify no duplicate invoice_line_id across export.
Priya Malhotra: Also request a sandbox GL posting for one sample customer to ensure `fee_passthrough` hits the right account. Creating ticket FIN-1350.
Evan Brooks: Approve to proceed with previews only. Final approval contingent on: projected delta < $20k for sample OR CFO sign-off. Please attach delta workbook.
Legal-Review-Bot: Notice draft uploaded: https://drive.internal/legal/tier_test_notice.md. Legal requests a clearer sentence on how credits will be issued (invoice credit vs account balance).
Maya Patel: Will update notice to specify invoice credit. @Zoe please run a quick run of `billing_recon --preview` against the CSV and post a diff.
Zoe Kim: Running recon now. Quick findings: 1) rounding parity holds except for Stripe 0.01 cases; 2) one sample account in preview had two invoice lines for the same model+window — likely exporter edge-case. Opening bug: BILL-402.
Gabe Lin: Add a CI smoke test that asserts unique invoice_line_id and model+window composite uniqueness.
Priya Malhotra: Once BILL-402 fixed and Stripe rounding mitigation documented, Finance Ops will run GL sandbox tests and validate FIN-1350.
Evan Brooks: OK. If fixes go in today, we can greenlight the 2% run tomorrow morning. Otherwise postpone.
Maya Patel: Thanks. I'll coordinate fixes with eng and update the rollout ticket with the final previews and delta workbook. Will also tag CFO if delta exceeds threshold.
billing-bot: Scheduled preview run: tier_cap_72h_2026_06 (2% sample) 1026-06-07 06:00 PT.
Maya Patel: Closing loop: please add any last comments before 16:00 PT. If none, we proceed with preview run and follow the ops checklist.
